com.sun.tools.javah

类 JavahTask

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.javah.JavahTask
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    NativeHeaderTool.NativeHeaderTask, Callable<Boolean>

    public class JavahTask
extends Object
implements NativeHeaderTool.NativeHeaderTask
    Javah generates support files for native methods. Parse commandline options and invokes javadoc to execute those commands.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.

    作者:
    Sucheta Dambalkar, Jonathan Gibbons
